home.bannerDescription: Rising through the endless sea of clouds at an altitude of 1,200 - 1,500 meters in Ha Giang, ancient tea trees with trunks spanning wider than two people can embrace have quietly absorbed the essence of nature over millennia. Proudly bearing the name of this legendary land, Lung Vai Tea honors and preserves these rare, authentic tea buds — an exquisite gift distilling the spirit of the mountains into every sublime cup.

values.traditionalDesc: Inheriting artisanal roasting and curing techniques from master craftsmen across generations, honoring nature's rhythm to preserve the authentic soul of ancient tea.
values.delicateDesc: Committed to 100% pure tea leaves harvested directly from the pristine Lung Vai region. Free of artificial flavoring and additives, preserving the crisp astringency and deep lingering sweetness of the primeval forest.
values.originalDesc: Rooted in meticulously selected prime tea buds, elegantly presented in refined packaging, elevating this highland heritage into an exquisite luxury gift.

home.productsDesc: From dew-kissed white Shan Tuyet buds to unique thorny tea tips, Lung Vai Tea presents the pinnacle of artisanal processing from centuries-old trees. Each creation is a sensory voyage — from the airy delicacy of loose leaves to the profound depth of aged compressed tea cakes.
home.visitDesc: Step away from the bustling city and find tranquility where clouds embrace mountain peaks. Embark on a journey to listen to the whispers of ancient forests, marvel at hundreds-of-years-old Shan Tuyet trees, and sit together on moss-covered stilt house verandas to savor tea brimming with the vital energy of heaven and earth.
home.newsDesc: Discover stories from the Lung Vai tea territory alongside essential tea wisdom: recognizing authentic quality, mastering the art of brewing, tea appreciation etiquette, and daily wellness.
home.bookTeaRoomDesc: Reserve an authentic tea appreciation space in our tea tasting rooms

teaGroups.luc-traDesc: A quintessential tea beloved across Vietnam, appreciated for its bold character, crisp astringency, and lingering sweet finish. Crafted from select 1-bud-1-leaf or 1-bud-2-leaf shoots in varied styles: curled, hooked, or kept straight. The meticulous artisanal processing produces the signature aroma and nuanced flavor of authentic green tea.
teaGroups.hong-traDesc: A premium black tea crafted from centuries-old Shan Tuyet ancient tea buds. Distinctive for its bold, mellow body, deep enduring sweetness, and radiant ruby-amber liquor.
teaGroups.bach-traDesc: A delicate, ethereal white tea harvested from tender primeval Shan Tuyet buds. Subtle and sweet, evoking wild honey and alpine mountain air.
teaGroups.pho-nhi-songDesc: Raw Sheng Pu'er tea aged to develop deep complexity over time. Currently updating availability, stay tuned.
teaGroups.set-qua-tangDesc: Curated tea gift collections, packaged with exquisite designs and premium presentation choices.

videos.item3Desc: Skilled hands tenderly hand-picking the purest nascent buds bestowed by heaven and earth.
videos.item4Desc: Nurturing traditional hearths, where Lung Vai Tea seals the cherished aromas of the mountains.
